headline: Argentine Government Increases Bus Subsidies to Freeze AMBA Fares Until January
summary: Following negotiations with business chambers, Argentina's transport ministry agreed to update operating costs and settle a 40 billion peso debt, freezing bus fares in the Buenos Aires metropolitan area until at least January.
why: Public transport subsidies and fare freezes impact government fiscal outlays and cost-of-living adjustments for urban workers.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Transport subsidies alter fiscal expenditure and urban service pricing structures.
